Planning guide

A little planning makes more room for the experience.

Bring your dates and questions together before confirming your Coron diving trip.

  1. Before you arrive.
  2. Know where your day starts.
  3. Pack for a day around the water.
  4. Conditions can change the plan.
  5. Leave space between diving and flying.
  6. Keep Coron worth coming back to.
  1. 01

    Before you arrive.

    Contact the team with your travel dates, group size and diving background. Keep your certification and recent dive information available if you're booking certified-diver activities.

  2. 02

    Know where your day starts.

    Confirm the meeting point and time directly with W Divers. Ask whether transfers are part of your arrangement before relying on hotel pickup.

  3. 03

    Pack for a day around the water.

    Bring personal essentials such as swimwear, a towel, sun protection, drinking water and a dry bag. Confirm supplied items and any equipment you plan to bring or rent.

  5. 04

    Conditions can change the plan.

    Sea conditions, weather and local access can affect the day's arrangements. Confirm how changes are handled before paying for your trip.

  6. 05

    Leave space between diving and flying.

    Tell the team about your onward travel before arranging dives. Flying after diving requires an appropriate surface interval; follow current guidance from your dive professional, your training and your dive computer. Read DAN's flying-after-diving guidance for general background.

    DAN: Flying after diving (opens in a new tab)

  7. 06

    Keep Coron worth coming back to.

    Follow your guide's instructions, maintain appropriate buoyancy, leave wrecks and marine life undisturbed, and take your waste back with you.
